description: This file defines an interface and utility functions for building and reusing nodes in an intermediate representation (IR) within the torch::lazy namespace, including an abstract IrBuilder class and related helper functions.

classes.name: IrBuilder
classes.description: Abstract interface for building IR nodes with various methods for creating device data, scalars, tensors, and dynamic size nodes.

methods.name: ReuseNode
methods.description: Attempts to reuse an existing IR node from cache if enabled.

methods.name: CacheNode
methods.description: Caches an IR node into the TrieCache if reuse is enabled.

methods.name: MakeNode
methods.description: Creates a new shared instance of a node of type T.

methods.name: MakeDeviceData
methods.description: Creates a device data node from shared backend data.

methods.name: MakeScalar
methods.description: Creates a scalar node from a value and type.

methods.name: MakeExpand
methods.description: Creates an expand node with specified size and scalar expansion flag.

methods.name: MakeCast
methods.description: Creates a cast node to a specified scalar type.

methods.name: MakeTensorList
methods.description: Creates a tensor list node from input operations.

methods.name: MakeGeneric
methods.description: Creates a generic IR node with specified operation, operands, shape, and optional outputs and hash seed.

methods.name: MakeSizeNode
methods.description: Creates a size node for a given input and dimension.

methods.name: GetSymIntValue
methods.description: Converts a symbolic integer to a Value object, handling both concrete and symbolic cases.

methods.name: GetSymIntArrayRefValue
methods.description: Converts a symbolic integer array reference to a vector of int64_t.
